channel.title: Zhangli Zhou research news
channel.description: Research updates, accepted papers, code, and demo news from Zhangli Zhou.

item.title: Congratulations to Zhangli Zhou (first author) on publishing "From Ambiguous Language to Verifiable Plans: Integrating Formal Synthesis and Dynamic Affordance Reasoning" in IEEE Transactions on Robotics.
item.description: From Ambiguous Language to Verifiable Plans: Integrating Formal Synthesis and Dynamic Affordance Reasoning has been published in IEEE Transactions on Robotics.

item.title: Congratulations to Hao Zhang and collaborators on publishing "Temporal Logic Guided Universal Task Representations for Reinforcement Learning" in IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems.
item.description: Temporal Logic Guided Universal Task Representations for Reinforcement Learning has been published in IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems.

item.title: Congratulations to Hao Li and collaborators on publishing "Relaxed Temporal Logic Motion Planning via Graphs of Convex Sets Under Partial Task Infeasibility" in IEEE Transactions on Industrial Electronics.
item.description: Relaxed Temporal Logic Motion Planning via Graphs of Convex Sets Under Partial Task Infeasibility has been published in IEEE Transactions on Industrial Electronics.

item.title: Congratulations to Lin Li and collaborators on publishing "A Formal Framework for Reactive Heterogeneous Multirobot Task Allocation in Uncertain Semantic Environments" in IEEE Transactions on Cybernetics.
item.description: A Formal Framework for Reactive Heterogeneous Multirobot Task Allocation in Uncertain Semantic Environments has been published in IEEE Transactions on Cybernetics.

item.title: Congratulations to Mingyu Cai and collaborators on publishing "Reinforcement learning with soft temporal logic constraints using limit-deterministic generalized Büchi automaton" in Journal of Automation and Intelligence.
item.description: Reinforcement learning with soft temporal logic constraints using limit-deterministic generalized Büchi automaton has been published in Journal of Automation and Intelligence.

item.title: Congratulations to Zhangli Zhou (first author) on having the paper "Dual Reactive Planning for Heterogeneous Robots With Evolving Capabilities in Unknown Environments" accepted by IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L).
item.description: Dual Reactive Planning for Heterogeneous Robots With Evolving Capabilities in Unknown Environments has been accepted by IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L).
